operations.name: sort
operations.question: how strongly is this protein relevant to a stated molecular-function query?

operations.name: rank
operations.question: how likely is this protein to be relevant to the stated molecular-function query?

operations.name: classify
operations.question: which broad protein class best fits the supplied RefSeq name, product description, and context?

operations.name: route
operations.question: which review queue should receive this protein record based on its supplied metadata and evidence context?

operations.name: map
operations.question: which high-level biological map best fits this protein without inferring an unsupported organism trait?

required_preconditions: observed protein row count equals 495,290,394 before a full-release run
PostgreSQL 14-17 with plpython3u and Jev installed
operator has approved sending the selected metadata to the Jev provider
run uses a non-secret query and an explicit spend/row cap
safety_and_scope: Jev output is a derived semantic signal, not a canonical biological assertion
Genomic coordinates and organism mappings remain deterministic source joins
Do not infer a protein-to-organism trait causal claim from a Jev label
Persist raw evaluation, model version, query, release, and retrieval time
semantic_query: relevance to a specified molecular function or protein-of-interest workflow

third_party_transfer.api_key_source: TYPESAFE_API_KEY or session setting; never stored in this plan
third_party_transfer.data_minimization: Jev view excludes raw protein sequence and sends metadata needed by the question
